confidence_notes: The RBA observation comes from a search result, which gave the 18 November 2026 4pm rate of 0.6720 USD per AUD. Food and coffee anchors rest on aggregated crowdsourced Numbeo-derived data (via Expatica, June 2026) and MyLifeElsewhere. These gave a meal at an inexpensive restaurant of about €18.7, a cappuccino of about €2.0-2.1, a 0.5L domestic draught beer of about €3.2-3.4, and a three-course meal for two of about €65. I converted euros to USD at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, which I did not look up. I found no reliable cocktail or wine price data. Those two are estimated from the local relationship to beer: a cocktail at about 3x a draught beer, and a restaurant glass of wine at about 1.1x a beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. They are the least certain, especially in July peak season, when Bilbao prices can swing widely.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bilbao is one of Spain's pricier cities, but cheaper than Madrid and Barcelona. The accommodation estimates use northern Spanish coastal and cultural-tourism cities of similar size, such as San Sebastián, which is somewhat costlier, and Valencia, as a mental benchmark.
